slide1.headline: EU AI Act: Commission Publishes Draft Guidelines
slide1.subtitle: For Identifying High-Risk AI Systems

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The European Commission has published draft guidelines for identifying high-risk AI systems
The guidelines are part of the EU AI Act and aim to ensure the safe and responsible development of AI
The commission has identified 13 categories of high-risk AI systems, including those used in healthcare and transportation
The guidelines will help businesses to understand their obligations under the EU AI Act

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The EU AI Act is a significant regulatory development for the AI industry
The guidelines will help to ensure that AI systems are developed and used in a responsible and safe manner
The commission's approach is focused on risk-based regulation, which will help to promote innovation while protecting citizens
